### Work in code with the Zapier SDK

Expose SurveySparrow actions from backend services, scripts, or agent code. Zapier handles the OAuth and scoped permissions. Access9,000\+ apps, plus thousands more with .fetch().

Install

```
npm install @zapier/zapier-sdk
npm install -D @zapier/zapier-sdk-cli
zapier-sdk login
# create a SurveySparrow connection @ https://zapier.com/app/assets/connections
```

Run an action

```
// Typescript
import { createZapierSdk } from "@zapier/zapier-sdk";

const zapier = createZapierSdk();

const { data: connection } = await zapier.findFirstConnection({ app: "surveysparrow", owner: "me" });

await zapier.runAction({
  app: 'surveysparrow',
  action: 'cesShare',
  connection: connection.id,
  input: {
    {inputKeyValuePairs}
  },
});
```

[Open the SDK docs](https://docs.zapier.com/sdk/quickstart)

Direct API calls to raw endpoints through`fetch` are not yet subject to org-level app and action restrictions.
